title: Hearty Herbal Slovakian Lamb Stew
description: A flavorful and herbal Slovakian lamb stew featuring chilli powder and salt-bake, perfect for a cold winter night. This low-fat-friendly dish is made in one pot for ease and convenience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, and chilli powder.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the lamb pieces on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, and dried thyme to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
